meta.name: monitoring-expert
meta.description: Configures monitoring systems, implements structured logging pipelines, creates Prometheus/Grafana dashboards, defines alerting rules, and instruments distributed tracing. Implements Prometheus/Grafana stacks, conducts load testing, performs application profiling, and plans infrastructure capacity. Use when setting up application monitoring, adding observability to services, debugging production issues with logs/metrics/traces, running load tests with k6 or Artillery, profiling CPU/memory bottlenecks, or forecasting capacity needs.

copy.tagline: 配置监控系统、日志管道和告警规则，快速定位生产问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在服务中搭建可观测性体系并快速诊断故障
copy.tagline_en: Set up monitoring, logging pipelines, and alerting to quickly debug production issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build observability into your services and diagnose issues fast

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你配置监控系统、搭建日志管道、创建 Prometheus/Grafana 仪表盘、定义告警规则、实现分布式追踪，还能进行负载测试、性能分析和容量规划。
howto.when: 当你需要设置应用监控、为服务添加可观测性、用日志/指标/追踪调试生产问题、运行 k6 或 Artillery 负载测试、分析 CPU/内存瓶颈或预测容量需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 Node.js 应用加上结构化日志和 Prometheus 指标。
写一个 k6 负载测试脚本，要求 95% 响应时间低于 500ms。
say.note: Claude 会输出包含阶段和阈值的 k6 脚本。

say.text: 为订单服务设置 OpenTelemetry 追踪和告警规则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help configure monitoring systems, set up structured logging pipelines, create Prometheus/Grafana dashboards, define alerting rules, instrument distributed tracing, run load tests, perform application profiling, and plan infrastructure capacity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to set up application monitoring, add observability to services, debug production issues with logs/metrics/traces, run load tests with k6 or Artillery, profile CPU/memory bottlenecks, or forecast capacity needs.

say_en.text: Help me add structured logging and Prometheus metrics to a Node.js app.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Pino logging and prom-client metric code.

say_en.text: Write a k6 load test script with 95th percentile under 500ms.
say_en.note: Claude will output a k6 script with stages and thresholds.

say_en.text: Set up OpenTelemetry tracing and alerting rules for an order service.
say_en.note: Claude will provide tracing code and Prometheus alert YAML.
